description: Reviewed disposition of both directions of the RACF command operand projection. The 68-name catalog-only baseline has 6 applied corrections and 62 reviewed, intended emulator spellings. Every source-only and syntax-only name is classified per command; syntax-only runtime behavior is additionally scoped to explicit command or operand contexts. The xtask gate enforces exact set equality and generates fail-closed runtime recognition.
